label: About
title: About A Crossing Holds Its Breath
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 1209 recent saved-signal files and 314 captured links, then narrowed the page to 9 source windows around @akiraxtwo: Built with GPT-5.5: a single-file Three.js voxel action-adventure scene. This... and Save 30% on Smash it Wild: Tactical Volleyball Roguelike on Steam, plus 7 more. A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became A Crossing Holds Its Breath: An abstract architectural threshold as game-space surface: elevated oblique close view of voxel terrain relief, broad landscape crop, parallel receding tile lines. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 9 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against Broad vermilion foreground gate-pillar face, Small dark recess between teal roof tiles, and Cream-sided missing paving tile.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
